fields.name: Chem De La Chem
fields.description: CHEM DE LA CHEM IS A SATIVA-DOMINANT HYBRID BRED FROM CHEMDAWG, I-95, TRIANGLE KUSH, LEGEND OG, AND STARDAWG. IT DELIVERS HIGH RESIN PRODUCTION, A COMPLEX FUEL-FOR- WARD AROMA WITH SWEET EARTHY NOTES, AND STRONG POTENCY.
fields.lineage: CHEMDOG x i95 (Triangle Kush x (Legend OG x Stardawg))

fields.name: Devil Driver
fields.description: DEVIL DRIVER BY TIKI MADMAN IS AN INDICA-DOMINANT HYBRID FROM SUNDAE DRIVER AND MELONADE GENETICS. KNOWN FOR ITS BOLD FLAVOR PROFILE— MELDING SWEET MELON, CITRUS, AND CREAMY NOTES— IT DELIVERS A POWERFUL, UPLIFTING HIGH WITH THC LEVELS REACHING UP TO 27% .

fields.name: Sherbert Og Fruit
fields.description: SHERBERT OG FRUIT COMBINES THE RICH DESSERT-LIKE SWEET- NESS OF SUNSET SHERBET WITH THE EARTHY DEPTH AND CITRUS SPICE OF OG KUSH. THIS INDICA-DOMINANT HYBRID DELIVERS POTENT, WELL-ROUNDED EFFECTS THAT OFFER RELIEF FROM STRESS, ANXIETY, PAIN, AND INFLAMMATION.
fields.lineage: Sunset Sherbert (Girl Scout Cookies x Pink Panties) x OG Fruit

fields.name: Tea Time
fields.description: TEA TIME IS A BALANCED HYBRID BRED BY WIZARD TREES, COM- BINING ZKITTLEZ AND RS11. IT OFFERS A SWEET, TROPICAL PROFILE WITH CREAMY SHERBET NOTES AND A SMOOTH, UPLIFT- ING YET RELAXING EFFECT.

fields.name: Tricko Jordan
fields.description: THIS NOVEL VARIETY OFFERS A UNIQUE AROMATIC PROFILE, COMBINING CHOCOLATE AND CHERRY-LIKE FLAVORS. ITS DIS- TINCT SCENT AND FLAVOR MAKE IT A STANDOUT CHOICE FOR GROWERS AND PATIENTS.

fields.name: Zunami
fields.description: ZUNAMI IS AN INDICA-DOMINANT CULTIVAR RESULTING FROM A CROSS OF ZKITTLEZ, GELATO 41, AND SHERB BX1. KNOWN FOR ITS DESSERT-LIKE AROMA WITH CANDY AND CREAMY UNDER- TONES, IT DELIVERS EUPHORIC AND RELAXING EFFECTS, HIGH THC CONTENT, AND STRONG APPEAL FOR EXTRACTION-FOCUSED GROWERS.
fields.lineage: Zunami x Zunami (Zkittlez x Gelato 41 x Sherb BX1)

fields.name: Watermelon Blast
fields.description: WATERMELON BLAST IS A HYBRID CULTIVAR CREATED THROUGH A COLLABORATION BETWEEN TIKI MADMAN AND MOSCA SEEDS. IT COMBINES WATERMELON ZKITTLEZ F2 AND WATERMELON GELATO F2, BOTH SELECTED FROM EXTENSIVE PHENO HUNTS.
fields.lineage: Watermelon Skittlez (Tiki Madman) x Watermelon Gelato (Lit Farm)

fields.name: Sour Melon
fields.description: SOUR MELON IS A BALANCED HYBRID DEVELOPED BY KARMA GENETICS FROM KG MELON CUT AND KG SOUR D BX. IT DELIVERS A POTENT CANNABINOID AND TERPENE PROFILE, COMBINING HIGH RESIN PRODUCTION WITH STRONG THERAPEUTIC POTEN- TIAL.
fields.lineage: KG Melon Cut x KG Sour D BX

fields.name: Super Boof
fields.description: SUPER BOOF IS A BALANCED HYBRID ( 50/50) RESULTING FROM THE CROSS OF BLACK CHERRY PUNCH AND TROPICANA COOKIES. WITH THC CONCENTRATIONS RANGING FROM 28% TO 32%, THIS CULTIVAR DELIVERS A POTENT AND FAST-ACTING EFFECT PRO- FILE.
fields.lineage: Black Cherry Punch x Tropicana Cookies
